Item.Name: S_EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Scan the equipment bar code, or enter 'M' for manual entry.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_start_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_end_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_len number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_len := length(temp_start_code);
 if :s_equipment_type = 'M' then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 if length(:s_equipment_type) != 6 + length(temp_start_code) + length(temp_end_code) then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('1210'); --invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 1, temp_len),'nullx') != nvl(temp_start_code,'nullx') or
 nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 7 + temp_len, length(temp_start_code)),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_end_code,'nullx') then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('6076'); --invalid start/end code
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
-- check and see if a valid equipment reference number
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1336');
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- check and see if authorized to make edits for equipment of this type

 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x
 from fcn_grp_priv f, equip_access_privs ea, equipment e
 where f.appl_id = 'DON'
 and f.user_id = upper(:banner.user_id)
 and ea.fcn_grp = f.grp_id
 and ea.equip_type = e.equip_type
 and e.equip_reference= 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1302');
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- set all ctrl blk and equipment block values, then populate all equipment details

 begin
 select e.equip_type, substr(m.code_desc,1,13), e.equip_id, e.equip_reference
 into :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type, :CTRL_BLK_1.s_equipment_desc, :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_id,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes m
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and m.code = e.equip_type
 and m.code_type = 'EQUIP';
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('EQUIPMENT_REFERENCE');
 execute_trigger ('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 end if;
end;

declare

 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);

 else

 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type;

 and e.fcn_grp = f.grp_id
 and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and v_local_date between e.eff_date and nvl(e.term_date,v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then

 end;

-- Verify that equipment of this type exists in the equipment table.

 begin

 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1325');

 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then

 end;

Item.Name: FIRST_PRODUCTION_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the original date this machine was placed into service.

Item.Name: LAST_PRODUCTION_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the date that this machine is permanently removed from service.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:equipment.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 if (nvl(:EQUIPMENT.first_production_date, :EQUIPMENT.last_production_date -1) >
 :EQUIPMENT.last_production_date) then
 begin
 show_error ('8050');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
--

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if ((:equipment.status = 'IN') and (v_local_date not between
 nvl(:equipment.first_production_date, v_local_date+1) and
 nvl(:equipment.last_production_date, v_local_date+1))) then
 begin
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := 'OUT';
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,40) into :EQUIPMENT.status2
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'STATS'
 and mc.code = :equipment.status;
 end;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if (:equipment.status is null) then
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 if (:equipment.status = 'IN') then
 begin
 begin
--
-- No other machine with same equip type and ID can be IN use
--
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :equipment.equip_type
 and e.equip_id = :equipment.equip_id
 and e.equip_reference != nvl(:equipment.equip_reference,0)
 and e.status = 'IN'
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x = 'X' ) then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1352');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- In service date must be entered
--
 if (:equipment.first_production_date is null) then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1353');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equipment.first_production_date > trunc(v_local_date))
 then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1354');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- Cannot be after machine was permanently removed from service.
--
 if (nvl(:equipment.last_production_date,v_local_date+1) < trunc(v_local_date))
 then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1355');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- See if machine is down for any reason
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equipment_event ee
 where ee.equip_reference = :equipment.equip_reference
 and v_local_date between
 ee.downtime_start and nvl(ee.downtime_end, v_local_date+1)
 and downtime_flag != 'C';
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 when others then null;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x = 'X' ) then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1356');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- See if machine has bad QC for last QC.
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_hdr qh
 where qh.equip_reference = :equipment.equip_reference
 and (qh.qc_result_1 = 'U' or
 qh.qc_result_2 = 'U' or
 qh.qc_status = 'U')
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr q1
 where q1.equip_reference = :equipment.equip_reference
 and qh.qc_type = q1.qc_type
 and qh.qc_date <= q1.qc_date
 and q1.qc_status = 'A');
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 when others then null;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x = 'X' ) then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1356');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- See if scheduled QC has not been successfully completed, within the periodic schedule
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr eqc, vequip_qc_frequency f
 where eqc.equip_type = :equipment.equip_type
 and eqc.qc_period = f.frequency_code
 and eqc.qc_period != 'V'
 and v_local_date between eqc.eff_date and nvl(eqc.term_date, v_local_date+1)
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr q1
 where q1.equip_reference = :equipment.equip_reference
 and eqc.qc_type = q1.qc_type
 and qc_status = 'A'
 and decode(eqc.qc_period, 'H', v_local_date, trunc(v_local_date)) < decode (eqc.qc_period,
 'H', q1.qc_date+(1/24*eqc.frequency),
 'D', q1.qc_date+(1*eqc.frequency),
 'W', q1.qc_date+(7*eqc.frequency),
 add_months(q1.qc_date, (f.months*eqc.frequency))));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when too_many_rows then
 :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x = 'X' ) then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1356');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- See if machine has its installation qualification record completed.
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equipment_qualification eq
 where :equipment.equip_reference = eq.equip_reference
 and nvl(eq.qualification_date, v_local_date+1) <= trunc(v_local_date)
 and eq.qualified_by is not null;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is null ) then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 show_error ('1357');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
end if;
--
 if (:equipment.status != 'OUT') then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and e.status = 'OUT';
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then
 show_error ('1355');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
-- check to see if out of service proper.
--
 if ((:equipment.status = 'OUT') and 
 (nvl(:equipment.last_production_date, v_local_date+1) >=trunc(v_local_date))) then
 show_error ('1374');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- check to see if new status is being placed on a machine that is not new.
--
 if (:equipment.status = 'NEW') then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and e.status = 'NEW';
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1373');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
--
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,40) into :EQUIPMENT.status2
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'STATS'
 and mc.code = :equipment.status;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_DETAIL_INFO_2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure pop_detail_info_2 is

 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
 cursor detail_info(p_local_date in date) is
--
-- Scheduled QC has not been successfully completed, within the periodic schedule.
--
 select eqc.qc_type a2,
 'Machine out of QC.' a1,
 to_char(nvl(decode (max(eqc.qc_period), 'H', max(qc.qc_date)+(1/24*max(eqc.frequency)),
 'D', max(qc.qc_date)+(1*max(eqc.frequency)),
 'W', max(qc.qc_date)+(7*max(eqc.frequency)),
 add_months(max(qc.qc_date), (max(f.months)*max(frequency)))), trunc(p_local_date)), 'MM-DD-RR')a3,
 ' ' a4,
 'NOT DONE' a5
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr eqc, vequip_qc_frequency f, equip_qc_hdr qc
 where eqc.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and eqc.qc_period != 'V'
 and eqc.qc_period = f.frequency_code
 and eqc.qc_type = qc.qc_type
 and qc.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and qc.qc_status = 'A'
 and p_local_date between eqc.eff_date and nvl(eqc.term_date, p_local_date+1)
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr q1
 where q1.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and qc.qc_type = q1.qc_type
 and qc_status = 'A'
 and decode(eqc.qc_period, 'H', p_local_date,trunc(p_local_date)) < decode (eqc.qc_period,
 'H', q1.qc_date+(1/24*eqc.frequency),
 'D', q1.qc_date+(1*eqc.frequency),
 'W', q1.qc_date+(7*eqc.frequency),
 add_months(q1.qc_date, (f.months*frequency))))
 group by eqc.qc_type;

 cursor detail_info_2(p_local_date in date) is
--
-- Scheduled QC never successfully completed.
-- 
 select 'Scheduled QC never done' a1,
 eqc.qc_type a2,
 ' ' a3,
 ' ' a4,
 'NOT DONE' a5
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr eqc 
 where eqc.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and eqc.qc_period != 'V'
 and p_local_date between eqc.eff_date and nvl(eqc.term_date, p_local_date+1)
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr q1
 where q1.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and eqc.qc_type = q1.qc_type
 and q1.qc_status = 'A')
 union
--
-- Unacceptable QC 
-- 
 select 'QC REF #: '||qh.qc_reference a1,
 qh.qc_type a2,
 to_char(qh.qc_date, 'MM-DD-YY') a3,
 null a4,
 substr(mc.code_desc,1,12) a5
 from equip_qc_hdr qh, equip_master_codes mc
 where qh.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and mc.code_type = 'QCSTS'
 and mc.code = qh.qc_status
 and (qh.qc_result_1 = 'U' or
 qh.qc_result_2 = 'U' or
 qh.qc_status in ('U', 'S'))
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr q1
 where q1.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and qh.qc_type = q1.qc_type
 and qh.qc_date <= q1.qc_date
 and q1.qc_status = 'A')
--
-- Unresolved downtime
--
 union
 select 'DOWN #: '||event_reference a1,
 downtime_code a2,
 to_char(downtime_start, 'MM-DD-YY') a3,
 nvl(to_char(downtime_end, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'None') a4,
 decode (nvl(downtime_flag, 'N'), 'N', 'Unscheduled',
 'Scheduled') a5
 from equipment_event ee
 where ee.equip_reference = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 and p_local_date between ee.downtime_start and
 nvl(ee.downtime_end, p_local_date+1);
 begin
 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 
 for c1 in detail_info(v_local_date) loop
 begin
 :status_detail.event := c1.a1;
 :status_detail.type := c1.a2;
 :status_detail.date1 := c1.a3;
 :status_detail.date2 := c1.a4;
 :status_detail.result := c1.a5;
 next_record;
 end;
 end loop;
 for c1 in detail_info_2(v_local_date) loop
 begin
 :status_detail.event := c1.a1;
 :status_detail.type := c1.a2;
 :status_detail.date1 := c1.a3;
 :status_detail.date2 := c1.a4;
 :status_detail.result := c1.a5;
 next_record;
 end;
 end loop;
 go_record ('1');
 if (:status_detail.event is null) then
 go_block ('equipment');
 go_item ('status');
 show_error ('1327');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE POP_EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES IS
 
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
 CURSOR EPV_DATA IS
 select vp.ref_number, vp.arrange_by, vp.parm_desc, vp.required_flag, vp.valid_code, 
 vp.type_of_data, vp.term_date, vp.eff_date
 from vequip_parms vp
 where vp.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 order by vp.arrange_by;
BEGIN 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 GO_RECORD ('1');
 FOR C1 IN EPV_DATA LOOP
 BEGIN
 if (nvl(:equipment_parm_values.ref_number, '0') != C1.ref_number) then 
 if ((trunc(v_local_date) >= C1.eff_date) and (trunc(v_local_date) <= nvl(C1.term_date, v_local_date+1))) then
 begin
--
-- Save existing values in globals
--
 :GLOBAL.c1 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_reference;
 :GLOBAL.c2 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_type;
 :GLOBAL.c3 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.ref_number;
 :GLOBAL.c4 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.arrange_by;
 :GLOBAL.c5 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_desc;
 :GLOBAL.c6 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_value;
 :GLOBAL.c7 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.required_flag;
 :GLOBAL.c8 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.valid_code;
 :GLOBAL.c9 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.type_of_data;
 :GLOBAL.c10 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.last_modified_date;
 :GLOBAL.c11 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.modified_by;
 :GLOBAL.c12 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.audit_key;
 :GLOBAL.c13 := :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.program_id;
--
-- Copy in new values
--
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_reference := :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_type := :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.ref_number := C1.ref_number;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.arrange_by := C1.arrange_by;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_desc := C1.parm_desc;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_value := null;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.required_flag := C1.required_flag;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.valid_code := C1.valid_code;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.type_of_data := C1.type_of_data;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.modified_by := :BANNER.user_id;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.audit_key := null;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.program_id := 'EQIEDIT';
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.s_seq_no := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
--
-- Create new record and place stored values in
--
 if (:GLOBAL.c3 is not null) then
 create_record;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_reference := :GLOBAL.c1;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_type := :GLOBAL.c2;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.ref_number := :GLOBAL.c3;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.arrange_by := :GLOBAL.c4;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_desc := :GLOBAL.c5;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_value := :GLOBAL.c6;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.required_flag := :GLOBAL.c7;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.valid_code := :GLOBAL.c8;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.type_of_data := :GLOBAL.c9;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.last_modified_date := :GLOBAL.c10;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.modified_by := :GLOBAL.c11;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.audit_key := :GLOBAL.c12;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.program_id := :GLOBAL.c13;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.s_seq_no := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 end if;
 end;
 else
 null;
 end if;
 else
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.s_seq_no := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 end if;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 GO_RECORD (1);
END;
